channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: Virginia court allows a referendum on Democrat-led redistricting that could flip 4 US House seats
item.description: The Virginia plan is part of a redistricting battle between some Republican and Democratic states.

item.title: Colorado governor signals willingness to release Tina Peters from prison amid Trump pressure
item.description: Trump threatened “harsh measures” against Colorado unless the state releases Peters.

item.title: US Homeland Security investigates whether Bovino made disparaging comments about Jewish faith
item.description: The investigation comes after reports on remarks Gregory Bovino allegedly made during a phone call.

item.title: Protester, three Capitol Police officers treated for injuries after scuffle in Senate hearing room
item.description: A man protesting the war in Iran has been arrested after a struggle.

item.title: Whether primary ballots set aside in two Texas counties will be counted remains uncertain
item.description: Democrats in deeply blue Dallas County say their hopes are dwindling

item.title: Trump’s White House ballroom is too big, architect says, as 2nd panel prepares to vote on it
item.description: A federal commission meets Thursday to consider the 90,000-square-foot project and to vote on whether to approve it.

item.title: Photo gallery from Milford vs. Fenton in a D1 girls basketball district semifinal
item.description: The Milford Mavericks started fast, then needed to rally, eventually rolling to a 41-31 win over Fenton in a Division 1 district semifinal at Howell HS on Wednesday, March 4, 2026.

item.title: Milford beats Fenton to get win No. 19 for the first time in 37 years, earn shot at No. 2 Howell
item.description: The result of a learned lesson was a 41-31 win over the Tigers, giving the Milford Mavericks a 19th win for the first time in 37 years, and sending them on to a district final for the third time in five seasons, hoping to win their first district title since 2015-16.

item.title: Photos of Clawson vs. Royal Oak Shrine in a D3 girls hoops district semifinal
item.description: Clawson defeated Royal Oak Shrine 46-37 to win its D3 district semifinal game at New Haven on Wednesday, March 4, 2026.

item.title: Clawson rides hot start to district semifinal win over Shrine, will meet Lutheran Northwest for championship
item.description: The Clawson Trojans raced out to a 17-3 lead then held off a couple of Royal Oak Shrine comebacks to defeat the Knights 46-37 in Wednesday’s district semifinal.
